messages:
Jasper: Anyone else seeing intermittent gRPC streaming stalls between gpu-pool pods and encoder services after the kernel patch reboots?

deploy-bot: Alert: model-serving/us-west-2-gpu stream error rate spike at 2026-03-17T05:12:00Z :warning:

Mona: I didn't touch CNI. We rolled kernel patches and rebooted nodes overnight. Which AZs/nodes are failing?

Jasper: It's mostly cross-AZ flows: node-azA-gpu-2 -> node-azB-enc-1. p99 tokens up, some streams freeze mid-request.

Kyle: On the client side tcpdump shows PMTU issues:
```
12:01:34.123 IP 10.1.2.45.54000 > 10.2.4.12.8000: Flags [P.], seq 1:1501, len 1500
12:01:34.124 IP 10.1.2.45 > 10.2.4.12: ICMP 10.2.4.12 unreachable - fragmentation needed and DF set (mtu = 1500)
```

Kyle: Source host interface had mtu 9000, leaf/ToR announces 1500. Large segments sent with DF cause ICMP frag-needed and then retransmits -> gRPC stalls.

Srini: That's especially nasty for RDMA/verbs flows. If the RDMA path expects jumbo, fragment drops break the semantics and stalls stream windows.

Mona: Quick remediation I applied: rolled out a DaemonSet that clamps TCP MSS on egress and restarted kube-proxy. Immediate recovery observed.

Kyle: DaemonSet iptables snippet we used:
```
iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu
```

Jasper: After clamp, ICMP frag-needed messages disappeared and p99 latency returned to baseline. We also temporarily toggled off GSO/GRO on a couple of hosts for testing.

Mona: Action items:
- Run cluster-wide MTU inventory (DaemonSet that reports `ip link show` + ToR MTU config)
- Add provisioning preflight to enforce node MTU parity or tag nodes that are jumbo-capable
- Adjust autoscaler to avoid mixing jumbo/non-jumbo nodes for RDMA-heavy node pools
- Create alert for sudden MTU drift after reboots

Jasper: Filed infra/ops#1298 to track longer-term fixes and autoscaler change.

infra-bot: Added staging healthcheck: /infra/tools/mtu-audit-daemonset.sh :white_check_mark:

Mona: TL;DR root cause = MTU skew after node reboots + RDMA flows. Hotfix = MSS clamp + kube-proxy restart. Medium-term = MTU inventory + autoscaler policy. :thumbsup:
